annotations.title: Scan a site for AI-agent readiness

description: Checks a public website from the outside: which AI agents its robots.txt allows or blocks (training crawlers, AI search crawlers, user-triggered assistants), whether its content is readable without JavaScript, and whether it offers llms.txt and markdown. Returns a 0–100 score, a grade and prioritised findings with recommendations. Takes a few seconds.
name: scan_site
title: Scan a site for AI-agent readiness
